translation_notes: prefixes: BFO->bfo, ABI->abi, CCO->cco, OWL->owl, RDF->rdf, RDFS->rdfs, XSD->xsd (each with 'as NAME' to keep the Namespace object for g.bind())

Literal(item)/Literal(prop_value) have no explicit datatype: bare interpolation {item} in +{ } goes through the same default coercion as rdflib's own Literal() inference, so no explicit Literal(...) constructor is needed inside the island
g += item.rdf(...) mutates in place (Graph.__iadd__ returns self), so a single @graph g at the top of the function stays valid throughout despite the later g += calls

driver.py builds duck-typed Entity/Leaf fixtures (with value-based __eq__) since RDFEntity.rdf is written against attribute access only; three calls cover the full property mix, an entity with none of the optional attributes, and the cycle-detection early return
